title: 上海高考翻译背诵-80-SSP高考专刊

items.zh: 那座村庄物资匮乏因为它不通车。
items.en: The village suffers from material shortages because it is inaccessible to transportation.

items.zh: 如果你能帮我解决我现在的维修问题,我会非常感激。
items.en: I would appreciate it if you could help me solve the current maintenance problem.

items.zh: 老师要求我们务必在期末考试前全面复习所有科目的知识点,以便在考试中取得优异的成绩。
items.en: The teacher required that we see to it that we go over all the key points of every subject comprehensively before the final exam so as to achieve excellent results.

items.zh: 约有400名学生参加了学校在5月8日举办的一年一度的科学论坛,在论坛上学生们可以展示他们的创新项目。
items.en: An estimated four hundred students participated in the annual science forum held at the school on May 8th, where they could display their innovative projects.
